versions.content: The function Fr_PrepareLPdu shall perform the following tasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx: 1. Figure out the physical resource (e.g., a buffer) mapped to the processing of the FlexRay frame identified by Fr_LpduIdx. 2. Configure the physical resource (a buffer) appropriate for Fr_LpduIdx operation (SlotId, Cycle filter, payload length, header CRC, etc.) if the MCG uses the reconfiguration feature5. 3. Return E_OK.
